mechanism: Torsemide causes electrolyte depletion and volume depletion which increases meclizine's anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects; both drugs can cause orthostatic hypotension and hypokalemia potentiates cardiac arrhythmia risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (especially potassium), blood pressure, and signs of excessive CNS depression; ensure adequate potassium supplementation with torsemide therapy.
